ownerThemes.theme: PatternReview owners across skill levels call it a smooth workhorse with excellent topstitching and repeatedly single out the knee lift and thread cutter as the features they would not give up.
A PatternReview discussion asks how to sew slower on the TL-2000Qi, since it has no speed slider and relies on pedal control.
Walmart reviewers rate it 4.4 of 5 but list weak lighting, a small needle hole and a presser foot that drags when free motion quilting with the foot down.

crossShop.why: Same machine with speed slider, pre-tensioner and two extra quilting feet for roughly $200 to $300 more.
Quilters weighing a 10 in computerized flatbed with utility stitches against a faster single-stitch head.
Beginners who want heavy fabric ability but also need zigzag and a buttonhole at a lower price.

editorial.verdict: The lowest-cost route to Juki's 1,500 spm straight-stitch head, provided you can live with pedal-only speed control.
editorial.whoFor: Quilters and heavy-fabric sewists who want the TL head, thread cutter and knee lift and would rather buy feet later than pay for the 2010Q's slider.
editorial.skipIf: You are new to fast machines and want a hard speed limiter, or you need any stitch other than straight.
editorial.keySpec: 1,500 spm · straight stitch only · knee lifter · 9 in arm
strengths: Dealers list the same 1,500 spm ceiling and aluminum die-cast body as the TL-2010Q.
Knee lifter, even feed foot and auxiliary table are in the standard box per the SMP listing.
Published net weight of 25.4 lb keeps it movable for classes or frame use.
weaknesses: No front speed slider; owners ask how to slow it down.
Straight stitch only, so it cannot be a first or only machine for garments.
Warranty terms and needle system were not found in accessible snippets and need dealer confirmation.

checks.title: Bonus pack vs box contents
checks.body: SMP's bonus package adds 20 L bobbins and 100 Organ needles plus a gift card. Compare that against the plain $899 dealer price before assuming it is a discount.

checks.title: Free motion feet are extra
checks.body: Unlike the 2010Q, the 1/4 and 1/5 in hopping feet are not listed in the box. Price them if you plan to quilt free motion.

checks.title: Weight on the listing
checks.body: Some listings show 37.8 lb. That is a shipping figure. Net weight is 25.4 lb; confirm before buying a carry bag.
